components.css: :host{--page:#0c0a09;--ink:#f5f5f4;--muted:#a8a29e;--secondary:#d6d3d1;--rule:#292524;--stroke:#44403c;--chip:#292524;--signal:#f87171;--sunset:linear-gradient(158deg,#fb923c 0%,#ef4444 50%,#b91c1c 100%);} .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;height:64px;padding:0 32px;background:rgba(12,10,9,.95);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--ink);} .ds-nav-name{font:600 20px/28px 'Afacad Flux Variable',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-0.025em;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;} .ds-nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;} .ds-nav-link{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px;font:500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;transition:color 150ms;} .ds-nav-link:hover{color:#fafaf9;} .ds-nav-toggle{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;margin-left:4px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;} .ds-nav-toggle:hover{background:var(--chip);color:#fafaf9;} .ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--signal);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px;} .ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--signal);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px;}

components.name: Cover Banner and Avatar
components.description: Sunset-gradient cover with the round avatar overlapping its lower-left edge; the page's one load motion.
components.css: :host{--page:#0c0a09;--ink:#f5f5f4;--muted:#a8a29e;--secondary:#d6d3d1;--rule:#292524;--stroke:#44403c;--chip:#292524;--signal:#f87171;--sunset:linear-gradient(158deg,#fb923c 0%,#ef4444 50%,#b91c1c 100%);} .ds-cover{background:var(--page);padding-bottom:8px;} .ds-banner{height:192px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--sunset);animation:ds-banner 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both;} .ds-avatar{width:160px;height:160px;margin:-80px 0 0 32px;border-radius:9999px;background:#d6d3d1;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--page);animation:ds-avatar 900ms 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both;} @keyframes ds-banner{from{clip-path:inset(0 0 22% 0 round 1rem);filter:saturate(.6);}to{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0 round 1rem);}} @keyframes ds-avatar{from{transform:translateY(10px) scale(.96);}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.ds-banner,.ds-avatar{animation:none;}}

narrative.northStar: The Profile You Already Know How to Read
narrative.overview:
This is the developer-portfolio standard, played straight. A slim sticky nav, a centred reading column, a cover banner with a round avatar overlapping its lower-left edge, a name at display size, two labelled outline buttons, then a vertical timeline of roles and schooling. Nothing asks to be learned. The craft is in exact spacing, honest hierarchy, and restraint rather than in any device the visitor has not seen before.

The world is warm stone in both modes, dark by default, with a single warm signature: the sunset gradient. It appears exactly twice, as the cover banner and as the current-role marker on the timeline, so the eye finds "who" and "now" without searching. A red signal (red-600 in light, red-400 in dark) carries interaction: focus rings, the outline-button hover, text selection, native control accents. Afacad Flux, self-hosted, gives the name and section headings a soft, slightly humanist voice; everything a recruiter actually reads is in the system sans.

Density is low and the page is short. Depth is flat: hairline rules and tonal fills, no shadows. Motion is a single load gesture on the cover and avatar, and it disappears under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone neutrals in light and dark; class-based dark mode, dark by default, persisted.
One sunset gradient, two placements: cover banner and current-role dot.
Red signal reserved for focus, the outline-button hover, and selection.
Afacad Flux for the name, nav name and section headings only; system sans for reading.
Flat surfaces: 1px stone rules and tonal chips, no shadows.
One load motion, 900ms, off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Two Placements Rule
rules.body: The sunset gradient appears on the cover banner and the current-role dot, nowhere else. A third placement dilutes "now".

rules.name: The Signal Is Interaction Rule
rules.body: Red is the answer to the visitor's hand: focus, hover on the primary links, selection. It never decorates static content.

rules.name: The No Text On Sunset Rule
rules.body: No text sits on the gradient. The old full-bleed header put white on orange; this world refuses it.

rules.name: The Display Is For Names Rule
rules.body: Afacad Flux sets the name, the nav name and section h2s. Titles, facts, dates and controls stay in the system sans.

rules.name: The Tabular Dates Rule
rules.body: Date ranges and durations use tabular numerals and sit right-aligned on desktop, stacked under the title on mobile.

rules.name: The Flat Stone Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px stone rule or a tonal fill. If a surface seems to need a shadow, it needs a rule instead.

dos: **Do** keep the sunset gradient to the cover banner and the current-role dot (158deg, orange-400 → red-500 → red-700).
**Do** use red-600 (light) / red-400 (dark) for focus outlines, outline-button hover and selection, and nothing static.
**Do** set the name and section headings in Afacad Flux at 600 with -0.025em tracking; set everything else in the system sans.
**Do** separate with 1px stone rules and tonal fills; seat circles on the page with a page-colour ring.
**Do** label every outbound link with its name, icon and an external-arrow, and announce new-tab behaviour to screen readers.
**Do** ship every motion behind `prefers-reduced-motion`; the 900ms banner and avatar reveal is the only load motion.
**Do** design both themes for every addition; dark is the default.
donts: **Don't** put text on the sunset gradient or run it full-bleed behind the header.
**Don't** add shadows, glows or glass effects; this world is flat stone.
**Don't** use Afacad Flux for body copy, dates, labels or controls.
**Don't** add new entrance or scroll animations beyond the single header reveal.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue; warm stone plus sunset plus signal red is the whole palette.
